slices.title: Timezone and language in the prompt
slices.summary: The SPA sends client_timezone, client_utc_offset_minutes and ui_locale on every turn. The BFF validates them (drops invalid, never invents) and model-gateway renders a local date/time/weekday notice plus a language line in the identity slot (Context tier), also on the Do preamble and ZDR direct stream. Pure functions live in a new locale_context.rs; switch off keeps the date notice byte-identical. No proto or migration.
slices.remaining: Whole slice: no code exists. Browser sends timezone, offset and ui locale; BFF validates; model-gateway renders local date/time and a language line behind a switch.

cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -q -p model-gateway --lib prompt_context
cd "apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3" && pnpm exec vitest run src/shared/api/chat-client.locale.test.ts

slices.title: One write-operations golden across exec-core, integration-corev2 allowlist and catalogue
slices.summary: Creates a write-operations golden (provider, operation, aliases, approval_required, direction, editable_kind) in integration-corev2 and a sha-pinned vendored copy in mp-contracts. The Go test asserts every write is gated by actionRequiresApproval and marked write in the provider catalogue; the Rust side adds a WRITE_OPERATIONS table with editable_kind() and an execution-core test that the is_write catalogue rows equal that table. Needs a sha2 dev-dependency in mp-contracts. No proto, no migration; docs/actions-surface-operations.md is not edited. If actionRequiresApproval is not reachable from the actions package, the Go test moves to internal/api.
slices.remaining: Whole slice: Go golden and test, vendored copy with sha pin, WRITE_OPERATIONS table in mp-contracts, execution-core catalogue test. Closes register D2-718.

slices.title: Per-thread text drafts on the chat page
slices.summary: Adds per-thread chat drafts under key prefix verevon.chat-draft.v1 (Home key unchanged, 30-thread cap, 400 ms debounce). A new useChatThreadDraft hook keeps drafts across reload and thread switch, restores on failed send, discards on accepted send, and never writes for Temporary chat, ZDR workspace or tainted text. Sign-out clears all chat drafts. No proto, no migration, no flag.
